scope.limitation: Verdict covers only the incremental memory optimization diff; it does not establish whole-product release readiness.

intent: Reduce cold background resident memory and idle CPU by deferring AWS setup until real S3 work and creating persistent settings/history/activity views on first activation. Preserve existing features, drafts, selections, diagnostics and safe teardown.

checked: R11/R12/R15: all views/actions and actual capability refresh remain reachable.
R20 and Success Criteria: deferral addresses cold background residency without disabling features; first-use latency remains a measurement gate.
R31/R34/R35: retained views keep state and existing services/visuals.
U3 SDK lifetime: owning runtime survives provider/client drain, with synchronized initialization/shutdown.
requirements_completeness.scope_note: U1-U10 are the broader product plan, not a claim of completion by this diff. The roughly 40 MiB target is unmet: caller reports 58,671,104-byte final cold background RSS versus 91,238,400-byte baseline and 0.003331% CPU over 300 seconds. Full desktop, S3 permission, capture latency, U9/U10 and visual acceptance remain outside this slice.

residual_risks: AWS initialization adds work to the first actual S3 request; no first-use capture-to-link latency was measured by this review. The SDK remains initialized thereafter.
Memory benefit is limited to cold background operation before first views and S3 use; retained windows continue their existing update work after activation.

The SDK owner contract remains required: all SDK objects and provider work must drain before owner destruction. This diff preserves main ordering; SDK/OpenSSL/Curl dependencies are uninstrumented in caller-reported sanitizer coverage.
Reported RSS improvement does not meet the roughly 40 MiB target and does not prove complete U10 performance or release acceptance.
testing_gaps: The exact reviewed HEAD changes six source files and adds no permanent tests. Its existing S3 fixtures use immediate initialization, leaving this exact tree without deferred lifecycle/concurrency and lazy-view regression coverage. Caller reports permanent SDK lifecycle/concurrent ensure tests in later canonical integration commits and green Dev/ASan/instrumented-Qt TSan runs; those distinct commits were not reviewed here.
Dedicated tests for source capability signals before view creation and during view teardown are absent in the exact reviewed tree.
No tests were executed during this review; reported Release suite and physical Cinnamon window mapping/reuse evidence were supplied by the caller. Offscreen results are not desktop acceptance.

coverage.peer_residual_reconciliation: Retained concrete first-use latency, post-activation memory and test-coverage limits. Did not adopt the speculative leak/owner misuse scenario as a defect. Startup journal recovery does not automatically resume S3 publication in inspected main/OperationService, so no claim that pending journals alone initialize AWS was retained.
